dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Next time, I'll grow the biggest one ever, bigger than all the ones I've grown before!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you selling?

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: The fruit and vegetables we grow in the Collective of Plenty of course. They're the best in the whole of Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bigger whats... exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Grainfruit, Tomatoes, Sunsettias, Onions... You name it, we grow it.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Did you know that I'm currently the producer of Natlan's biggest Grainfruit?

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: But I haven't reached my limit yet, not by a long shot. I'm certain that my land has far more potential.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: I've decided that once I've grown even bigger fruits, I'll display them in Yantasar's store for all to see.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: As people taste the delicious drinks she makes from the fruit and veg I grow, they'll be able to see how big and beautiful they are with their own two eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Then my store's reputation will start booming too, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and wish me the best of luck!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem very confident.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: But it's not just down to my efforts alone. Our Collective of Plenty is situated right by a volcano, where the soil was already rich and fertile to begin with.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: And cultivating land like this is much easier thanks to the fact that we can draw upon the awesome power of the Tatankasaurs.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: So when I said that the fruit and vegetables we grow in the Collective of Plenty are the best in the whole of Natlan, I wasn't just bragging. That's something everyone knows.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Haha, is that an attempt to goad me?

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: It's fine. Every first-time customer here receives a greeting gift, regardless of whether they buy something or not.

dialogues.speaker: Cintli
dialogues.text: Once you've had some, you'll know the I speak only the truth.
